research_scope: PQ81-PQ90 base-game Parallel Quest audit. Objective sequences and documented basic rewards are recorded; exact reward-slot/drop percentages remain unresolved unless directly established.

record_level_source_pass.note: Added individual provenance to all ten records and corrected the missing difficulty metadata to the documented 7-star tier. Independent tables agree on objective sequences and basic rewards. PQ83's progression has community evidence for the 81→82→83 chain, while broader documentation states that base-game PQs can also be surfaced through story progression and Conton City NPCs; therefore individual unlock_condition fields remain conservatively unresolved where the evidence does not establish a unique trigger. Exact reward-slot/drop percentages remain unresolved.
